After being hit, evading further damage for 10s heals back some health.
Falling below 35% max health instantly restores all of your stamina.
All magic damage you take is reduced by 25 (flat), calculated after magic amp/resist. Magic damage reduced to 0 still has a small chance to proc its secondary effect.
While wearing armors of different weights you gain bonus armor and bonus health.
Every 25s, upon reaching max stamina you consume half of it and your stamina regen is suppressed for 2s to regain health.
Every 22s you reflect the next instance of magic damage back at its instigator.
Every 25s your next melee or ranged attack heals you.
When taking magic damage you gain 700 armor for 16s.
Dealing or taking damage or harvesting has a small chance to give you a Shard of Notion.
Harvesting religious organs has a small chance to give you a Shard of Notion.
Killing blows dealt by any thralls, pets, or golems currently following you have a chance to grant you a Shard of Notion.
Falling below 20% max health knocks back all nearby enemies and heals a large amount of health over 6s. 90s cooldown.
When taking physical damage you gain 15% magic resist for 16s.
When taking any damage you have a 20% chance to instantly heal half of it back.
Surviving a weapon attack that brings you below 10% health makes you immune to all further damage for 10 seconds.
While knocked down you become immune to further damage until you get back up.
While below 15% max health all damage over time effects are cleansed and you become immune to new applications of them.
